reason: An ecommerce operations assistant that automates review-reply drafting, public-page-based listing copy generation, and formula-based product scoring using workspace files and supplied inputs.

summaries.zh: 面向电商商家的工作流插件，可批量读取评论表和售后政策生成回复、根据公开商品页面起草商品文案，并按固定公式进行商品评分。
summaries.en: An ecommerce operations workflow plugin that reads review tables and store policies to draft replies, creates listing copy from public product pages, and calculates product scores with a fixed formula.

capabilities: Reads CSV files from the selected workspace
Reads store-policy documents from the selected workspace
Fetches information from public product pages
Generates review replies and product listing copy
Computes product profitability and recommendation scores from provided inputs
